cards.text: Jesus is teaching in the temple courts, and the chief priests, the temple's leading priests, and the elders of the people, the people's leaders, just asked Him who gave Him His authority (Matthew 21:23). He answered with a story about two sons (Matthew 21:28-31). Now He tells them another parable.
A landowner plants a vineyard, puts a wall around it, digs a winepress in it and builds a tower. Friend, this man didn't just plant a vineyard, he gave it a SECURITY SYSTEM.

cards.question: The landowner rents his vineyard out to some tenants. Then what does he do?
Harvest time draws near, and the landowner sends his servants to the tenants. Why?

answers.text: To collect his share of the fruit
To help bring in the harvest
To check on the wall and tower

cards.text: So this is where the tenants hand it over, right? NOPE. They seize the servants.

cards.question: The tenants beat one of the landowner's servants, kill another and stone a third.

cards.text: When nobody answers my first text, I send FIVE more. This landowner's the same way: he sends other servants, more than the first group.

cards.question: The tenants treat the landowner's second, bigger group of servants better than the first.

cards.text: Finally, the landowner sends somebody new. Somebody close to him.

cards.question: Finally, the landowner sends his ___ to the tenants.
The landowner sends his son to the tenants. What does he expect them to do?

cards.text: But the tenants see the son coming and say to one another, "This is the heir." Friend, they are NOT rolling out the welcome mat.

cards.question: The tenants see the landowner's son, the heir. What do they plan to do?

answers.text: Kill him and take his inheritance
Send him back with a message

cards.question: The tenants seize the landowner's son and kill him right there inside the vineyard.

cards.text: That's the story. Now Jesus asks His listeners a question: when the owner of the vineyard returns, what will he do to those tenants?

cards.question: Jesus asks His listeners what the vineyard owner will do to those tenants. What do they answer?

answers.text: Bring them to a wretched end and rent to others
Forgive them and let them keep the vineyard
Sell the vineyard and never come back

cards.question: Jesus' listeners say the new tenants will give the owner his share of the fruit at harvest time.

cards.text: Then Jesus asks if they've never read in the Scriptures about the stone the builders rejected, from Psalm 118:22. Friend, when somebody starts with "Have you never read," you sit up STRAIGHT.

cards.question: In the Scripture Jesus quotes, what happens to the stone the builders rejected?

answers.text: It gets left in the field

cards.question: The Scripture Jesus quotes says what happened to the rejected stone is from the Lord.

cards.text: Then Jesus tells His listeners that the kingdom of God will be taken away from them. Friend, the story just walked right off the page and sat down next to them.

cards.question: Jesus says the kingdom of God will be taken away from His listeners. Who will it be given to?

answers.text: A people who will produce its fruit
The servants who were sent first
The builders who rejected the stone

cards.text: Then Jesus says that whoever falls on this stone will be broken to pieces. And whoever it falls on will be crushed.

cards.question: The chief priests and the Pharisees, a Jewish group known for strictly keeping the Law, hear Jesus' parables. What do they realize?

answers.text: Jesus is speaking about the crowds
Jesus is speaking about tax collectors

cards.text: They want to arrest Jesus. But they don't.

cards.question: The chief priests and Pharisees don't arrest Jesus because they're afraid of the ___, since the people regard Him as a ___.

cards.text: And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend. Tie that apron tight, because this teaching isn't done.
